waypoints.name: Blue Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 to the signed Blue Lake Trailhead on the south side of the highway, about 1 mile west of Washington Pass. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park.

waypoints.name: Liberty Bell summit
waypoints.directions: Follow the Blue Lake Trail about 1.5 miles to the cairned climbers' trail junction, then take the climbers' path up talus and slabs into the gully below the Liberty Bell-Concord notch, breaking left at the fork to the shelf and ramp below the cave at the base of the southwest corner. Climb the crack pitches and finish on 4th-class scrambling to the summit.
